tables.name: media_file
tables.title: 文件元信息与业务绑定

columns.name: id
columns.comment: 主键，自增，接口输出十进制字符串

columns.name: business_type
columns.type: VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

columns.name: business_id
columns.comment: 绑定业务 ID；未绑定为 NULL

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: 资源内展示顺序，头像 0，其余 1–9

columns.name: storage_key
columns.type: VARCHAR(255) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.comment: 文件存储相对键，不返回磁盘路径

columns.name: original_name
columns.comment: 原文件名，仅供管理内部使用

columns.name: mime_type
columns.type: VARCHAR(80) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin
columns.comment: 经文件特征校验后的 MIME

columns.name: status
columns.type: VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin

columns.name: active_business_id
columns.comment: 仅有效绑定参与展示位置唯一约束
columns.generated: CASE WHEN `status`='BOUND' THEN `business_id` ELSE NULL END

columns.name: cleanup_after
columns.comment: 允许清理文件的 UTC 时间；有效绑定为空

columns.name: updated_at
columns.comment: 更新时间，UTC，由 Service 显式维护

checks: (`status`='TEMP' AND `business_id` IS NULL AND `sort_order` IS NULL) OR (`status`='BOUND' AND `business_id` IS NOT NULL AND `sort_order` IS NOT NULL) OR `status`='DELETED'
`sort_order` IS NULL OR (`business_type`='AVATAR' AND `sort_order`=0) OR (`business_type`<>'AVATAR' AND `sort_order` BETWEEN 1 AND 9)

(`mime_type` IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp','image/gif') AND `size_bytes` BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880) OR (`business_type` NOT IN ('AVATAR','PRODUCT') AND `mime_type` IN ('video/mp4','video/webm') AND `size_bytes` BETWEEN 1 AND 20971520)
relations: 按 business_type 指向 sys_user / adoption_pet / community_post / shop_product
多态逻辑外键，Service 校验归属、用途、权限
tables.note: 文件本体放文件系统或对象存储，MySQL 只保存元信息。DELETED 保留原关联便于禁止读取，生成列释放旧展示位置。

columns.comment: 关联业务 ID，平台公告为 NULL

columns.comment: 群发主记录 ID，普通业务消息为空

columns.comment: 1 群发主记录；0 实际收件消息

columns.comment: 群发范围，仅群发主记录填写

columns.comment: 群发主记录的实际收件人数；普通消息为 0

checks: (`is_read`=0 AND `read_at` IS NULL) OR (`is_read`=1 AND `read_at` IS NOT NULL)

(`is_broadcast`=1 AND `recipient_id` IS NULL AND `broadcast_id` IS NULL AND `created_by` IS NOT NULL AND `target_type` IS NOT NULL AND `target_type` IN ('ALL','USERS') AND `business_type`='SYSTEM' AND `is_read`=0) OR (`is_broadcast`=0 AND `recipient_id` IS NOT NULL AND `target_type` IS NULL AND `created_by` IS NULL AND `recipient_count`=0)
tables.note: 群发主记录与收件消息共表。先建 is_broadcast=1 的主记录，再建立每个用户的消息并关联 broadcast_id；均在同事务提交。收件查询必须限定 recipient_id=当前用户 AND is_broadcast=0；Service 验证 broadcast_id 只指向主记录。允许收件人数为 0 的主记录。

tables.note: 先认证鉴权，再查重。成功记录与业务同事务提交；失败事务回滚记录。应用密钥不在数据库保存，防止临时密码幂等响应明文落库。
